title: celtis occidentalis var. canina
intro: Celtis occidentalis var. canina, commonly known as American hackberry var. canina or dog hackberry, is a variety of the American hackberry plant, which is native to the eastern and central regions of North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and act as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Celtis occidentalis var. canina include anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
